Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging. Overview Senior Software Engineer – Java Technologies & AI-Enabled SDLC Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer specializing in Java technologies to design, develop, test, and deliver scalable, secure, and reliable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, cloud-native development, DevOps, and automated testing , with demonstrated ability to leverage AI and Generative AI technologies across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing efficiency, and speed to market. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical ownership, problem-solving capabilities, collaboration, and a continuous-improvement mindset. Key Responsibilities Java Engineering & Application Development Design, develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise applications using Java and Java/Jakarta EE technologies . Develop scalable services and APIs using Spring, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture . Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and design principles. Participate in solution design, technical design reviews, code reviews, and architecture discussions. Troubleshoot complex application, integration, performance, and production issues. Develop unit and integration tests and ensure adequate automated test coverage. Support application modernization, technical-debt reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA, architects, DevOps engineers, and production support teams throughout the SDLC. AI-Enabled SDLC Actively use AI-assisted software engineering tools and Generative AI capabilities to accelerate development activities across the SDLC. Apply AI to improve requirements understanding, solution design, code generation, code refactoring, unit-test creation, test-data generation, defect analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting . Effectively use enterprise-approved AI coding assistants, such as GitHub Copilot , where available. Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, performance, and alignment with enterprise engineering standards rather than accepting generated code without validation. Identify repetitive engineering activities that can be automated or accelerated through AI agents, reusable prompts, workflows, or engineering accelerators . Contribute reusable AI-enabled engineering assets, patterns, and best practices that can be adopted by other development teams. Measure and demonstrate improvements achieved through AI adoption, including engineering productivity, development cycle time, quality, automation, and reduction of repetitive manual effort. Ensure AI-assisted development complies with applicable organizational standards for security, privacy, intellectual property, data protection, and responsible AI usage . How you'll make an impact Required Technical Skills Strong hands-on experience with Java , with solid understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, design patterns, concurrency, exception handling, and performance optimization. Strong experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot . Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices . Experience with persistence technologies such as JPA/Hibernate and relational databases. Strong understanding of SQL and database design concepts. Experience with build and dependency-management tools such as Maven or Gradle . Experience with automated unit and integration testing using technologies such as JUnit, Mockito, REST Assured, or equivalent frameworks . Experience with source-control and CI/CD practices using technologies such as Git and Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms . Understanding of containerized application development using Docker and exposure to Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms. Experience developing or supporting applications deployed to a major cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform . Strong knowledge of secure coding, application security, logging, monitoring, exception management, and production-support practices. AI & GenAI Skills Practical experience using Generative AI or AI coding assistants within software engineering activities. Ability to create effective prompts and provide sufficient technical context to AI tools for software-development use cases. Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, unit-test generation, documentation, debugging, code explanation, and engineering productivity . Understanding of the limitations and risks of AI-generated code and the importance of human review and validation. Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), APIs, and enterprise AI integration patterns is preferred. Exposure to technologies such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, or comparable enterprise GenAI platforms is preferred. Engineering & SDLC Expectations The Senior Software Engineer will be expected to take ownership across the engineering lifecycle: Requirements Design Development Code Review Unit Testing Integration Testing Deployment Production Support Continuous Improvement The engineer should continuously look for opportunities to incorporate AI, automation, reusable components, and engineering accelerators into this lifecycle while maintaining appropriate quality and governance controls. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience , with substantial hands-on Java development experience. Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise applications in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to independently own complex development assignments from design through production implementation. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across business, development, QA, architecture, infrastructure, and support teams. About you Preferred Qualifications Experience with enterprise application modernization and migration from legacy or monolithic architectures to microservices and cloud-native architectures . Experience with event-driven or messaging technologies such as Kafka . Experience supporting highly available, business-critical production applications. Knowledge of API security, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, application observability, and performance engineering . Experience developing AI agents or AI-enabled engineering accelerators . Experience integrating enterprise applications with LLMs or GenAI services . Relevant Java, cloud, DevOps, or AI certifications are an advantage. Key Competencies Strong technical ownership and accountability Hands-on Java engineering expertise AI-first and automation-first mindset Strong debugging and root-cause-analysis skills Secure and quality-focused engineering practices Ability to work effectively across global and distributed teams Continuous learning and technology adoption Clear communication and collaboration Focus on delivering measurable business value through technology Success Measures Success in this role will be demonstrated through: Delivery of reliable, maintainable, and secure Java applications Improved engineering productivity through practical adoption of AI Increased automation and reduced repetitive development effort Strong automated test coverage and reduced escaped defects Improved development and defect-resolution cycle times Creation and reuse of AI-enabled engineering accelerators Consistent adherence to architecture, security, quality, and SDLC standards Additional Information At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page. Competitive compensation Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being Career development opportunities and ongoing learning A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Kochi, India | Full time | Hybrid | R1571699 Job Overview We are seeking an Automation Engineer to develop, maintain, and execute automated test solutions that ensure the quality and reliability of complex software applications. This role will work closely with development and QA teams to improve test coverage, accelerate release cycles, and support continuous delivery initiatives. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks. Execute and support automated regression testing across multiple product releases. Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid feedback. Create, manage, and track defects, test cases, and test execution results using JIRA and TestRail. Leverage AI-powered development tools to accelerate test automation development, script maintenance, troubleshooting, and productivity. Analyze, document, and resolve software defects. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve quality processes and testing efficiency. Identify opportunities to expand automation coverage and reduce manual testing effort. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. 2+ years of experience in software testing and test automation. Experience with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD processes. Hands-on experience with JIRA for defect and project tracking and TestRail for test case management and test execution. Proficiency in using AI-assisted development tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, or similar technologies to improve automation scripting efficiency, code quality, test creation, and troubleshooting. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively with both onshore and offshore teams. Self-motivated, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies. Preferred Experience with automated regression testing and test framework development. For internal candidates, working knowledge of IQVIA's Proprietary Automation Framework (PAF) is strongly preferred. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism. Where you'll work Hybrid You’ll split your time between home and the office, giving you the flexibility to focus where you work best while still building strong in-person connections with your team. This model combines the autonomy of remote work with the collaboration, energy and resources of an office environment. Culture Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

title: Sr. Mendix Developer
description: Job Summary Sr Product Specialist T will design and enhance Mendix solutions that optimize core business processes in a hybrid work model while collaborating with cross functional teams to deliver secure scalable and integrated applications that support life and annuities insurance operations and advance the organization digital transformation goals and customer experience. Responsibilities Drive the design and configuration of Mendix applications that align with complex business requirements ensuring robust functionality and maintainability across the full product lifecycle. Manage Mendix security configurations by defining access rules user roles and data protection measures that safeguard sensitive customer and policy information and support regulatory compliance. Coordinate Mendix integration activities with enterprise platforms core insurance systems APIs and external services to enable seamless data flow and consistent user experience across channels. Optimize Mendix application performance by analyzing usage patterns refining data models and tuning microflows to deliver responsive and reliable solutions for day to day business operations. Collaborate with business analysts architects and testers to translate user stories into Mendix features that are clearly scoped well documented and traceable from requirement through deployment. Guide configuration of reusable Mendix components and widgets that promote standardization accelerate future development and reduce defects across multiple product initiatives. Conduct impact analysis and change assessments for Mendix enhancements ensuring that new capabilities integrate cleanly with existing processes and minimize disruption to operations. Oversee quality assurance activities for Mendix solutions including test case review functional validation and defect triage to support stable and predictable releases. Coordinate user enablement activities by preparing reference materials walkthroughs and demonstrations that help stakeholders adopt new Mendix features and realize measurable business value. Evaluate production incidents and service requests related to Mendix applications identifying root causes recommending corrective actions and preventing recurrence through proactive improvements. Support life and annuities insurance business processes by configuring Mendix features that improve policy servicing claims handling and customer service workflows when domain scenarios are involved. Align Mendix solution roadmaps with organizational objectives by prioritizing enhancements that improve customer outcomes streamline operations and support responsible growth for society. Maintain clear documentation of Mendix configurations integration patterns and security controls to enable sustainable operations and smooth handover across teams and locations. Qualifications Demonstrate strong proficiency in Mendix application development with hands on experience delivering secure and scalable solutions over at least five years in complex environments. Possess deep practical understanding of Mendix security features including role based access data security policies and secure deployment practices to protect sensitive information. Exhibit solid experience in Mendix integration including configuration of connectors orchestration of external services and collaboration with middleware teams to ensure reliable data exchange. Apply sound Mendix design principles and best practices to model data microflows and UI components that balance usability maintainability and performance for business applications. Bring exposure to life and annuities insurance processes and terminology enabling more meaningful engagement with stakeholders and better alignment of Mendix solutions to domain needs. Utilize strong analytical and problem solving capabilities to assess requirements interpret business goals and convert them into Mendix features that deliver tangible operational benefits. Work effectively in a hybrid environment by using collaboration tools communication practices and documentation discipline that keep distributed team members aligned on Mendix delivery outcomes. Certifications Required Mendix Advanced Developer certification or equivalent Mendix platform credential.
